subject: computer-science
title: Semantic Web, Ontologies and SPARQL
welcome_lead: Teach machines to understand meaning using RDF triples and SPARQL queries.
meta_desc: IBDP HL CS adventure on semantic web, ontologies, RDF and SPARQL.
final_note: RDF triples (s, p, o) form the semantic web's bricks!

walkthroughs.body_html:
(Alice, knows, Bob) expresses Alice knows Bob.

Subjects, predicates and objects are URIs in formal RDF.

FOAF (Friend of a Friend) provides knows, name etc.

Adopting a common ontology aids data integration.

SELECT ?friend WHERE { :Alice :knows ?friend }

Pattern matches the triple store and returns matches.
